objective: Consent cannot be bypassed by editing the timeline directly

parts.part: YU-051b placement consent at the store's commit point

deviations: Audit: applyBatch committed with no consent check; clip.add, replaceMedia, setSound, undo, redo, restore, a re-import of the same file, unmuting or ending a solo could present a revoked take again

One guard at ProjectStore.#commit for every commit but project creation: a medium newly presented (seen or heard on a track that plays by the render's mute and solo rule, keyed by content hash) that is the recorded output of a take with continuity references needs every consent usable now
Restore is checked (a revoked consent can never be revalidated); a recovery restore over an undecodable head treats nothing as presented
A commit presenting nothing new reads no story; one that does scans story versions once for all new hashes
evidence: docs/OPERATIONAL_CONTRACTS.md (Continuity references and per-stage consent, Every timeline commit)

tests.result: 15/15; the direct-edit tests fail without the guard and the restore and voice tests fail against the round-1 guard (the bypass returned ok)
